metadata.title: The RFxchange™
metadata.description: A map-based business growth network for capability discovery, opportunities, referrals, partnerships, resources, and measured activity.
metadata.openGraphDescription: Make business capability, opportunity, and connection easier to discover and act on.

footer.summary: A local business growth network beginning with real organization, capability, geography, and activation—then extending through governed releases.

hero.eyebrow: A Local Business Growth Network · By Accel Analysis
hero.titleBefore: The local market is already moving.
hero.summary: The RFxchange gives organizations a shared environment to be discovered by capability and, as each governed workflow is released, move from visibility into opportunity, referral, teaming, and support.
hero.evidenceNote: Stock photography supplies atmosphere only. It does not depict RFxchange participants, opportunities, outcomes, testimonials, or live platform activity.

availability.title: See what is live—and what is still being built.
availability.description: The RFxchange does not manufacture market activity for presentation. Current capabilities, active development, and later product pathways are identified separately.

items.title: Establish your organization
items.detail: Create an account, select an authoritative locality, resolve or create the organization, confirm its location, add a meaningful capability, and complete the governed activation journey.

items.title: Become visible on the map
items.detail: A successfully activated organization receives its real or privacy-safe organization node in the correct controlled geography and enters the authenticated Exchange workspace.

items.title: Discover the live Network
items.detail: Capability search, permitted organization discovery, referrals, official resource providers, and richer Network lenses are being released through the adopted Wave 3 sequence.

items.title: Move through RFx and outcomes
items.detail: The RFx transaction engine, credibility evidence, and outcome expressions remain later governed domains. Diagrams describe the product model, not current market activity.

live.title: Your organization comes into focus around real geography.
live.description: The current activation journey moves from account establishment to a real organization node without requiring invented opportunity data, provider status, business objectives, or a paid plan.

steps.title: Create the account
steps.detail: Establish a verified participant identity and accept the governing policies.

steps.title: Select the locality
steps.detail: Use authoritative geography to establish the organization’s operating context.

steps.title: Resolve the organization
steps.detail: Find, claim, or create the organization without inventing authority.

steps.title: Confirm the location
steps.detail: Geocode and confirm a real or privacy-safe location on the map.

steps.title: Describe one capability
steps.detail: Add the minimum meaningful capability needed for Profile Complete.

steps.title: Activate the organization node
steps.detail: Complete orientation and enter the authenticated Exchange workspace.

model.title: One market environment. A governed path from visibility to evidence.
model.description: This is the approved product model. Later steps appear in the live product only after their owning domains, permissions, evidence, and acceptance tests are implemented.
model.label: Planned product model · not live market activity

steps.title: Organization
steps.detail: A real organization and its capabilities become visible subject to permission.

steps.title: Opportunity
steps.detail: A later RFx publication domain introduces structured business demand.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.detail: Potential fit is explained without claiming qualification or endorsement.

steps.title: Relationship
steps.detail: Referrals, teams, and providers require real governed relationship records.

steps.title: Workflow
steps.detail: The participant moves through an authorized operational workflow.

steps.title: Outcome
steps.detail: Credibility and outcomes appear only when authoritative evidence exists.

difference.eyebrow: A living market—not a conventional dashboard
difference.title: Built around organizations, geography, and business action.

items.label: More than a directory
items.detail: The live activation experience establishes an organization, its capability, geography, and real map presence. Later governed releases extend that position into Network and RFx workflows.

items.label: Not a social feed
items.detail: The product is organized around organizations, capabilities, geography, and authorized business workflows—not follower counts, general posting, or invented activity.

items.label: Broader than a bid portal
items.detail: The planned RFx engine belongs inside a wider local business growth network. Until that engine is released, public copy identifies it as planned rather than presenting it as live.

connection.title: Context should travel with the participant.
connection.description: The product is designed so a capability, need, organization, geography, and next action can remain connected. Referrals, teaming, provider routing, and RFx activity are introduced only through their authorized implementation slices.

audience.title: A practical environment for the people who move local business.

items.name: Economic developers + civic leaders
items.detail: Begin with real organization and geography visibility; later governed releases add resource coordination and measured network activity.

items.name: Businesses
items.detail: Establish the organization and its capabilities now, then use Network and RFx workflows as they become available.

items.name: Resource providers
items.detail: Official provider application, routing, and service-territory discovery remain controlled Wave 3 releases rather than self-selected registration roles.

evidence.title: Real evidence—or a clear label.
evidence.description: Marketing and product surfaces must not imply organizations, opportunities, statistics, outcomes, testimonials, provider availability, or dashboards that do not exist.
rules: Stock photography is visual atmosphere, never proof of RFxchange activity.
Synthetic tutorial content remains labeled and isolated from live records.
Future product capabilities are identified as planned or in development.
Public opportunity context never grants private access or domain authority.
Credibility and outcomes require authoritative evidence before presentation.

cta.description: Start with the part that is live: establish your organization, confirm its geography, describe its capability, and become visible in the authenticated Exchange.
